title: Theo and Fern's Big Pen Secret
markdown:
The sun cracked the sky! Brilliant light burst through workshop windows. It tickled Theo’s nose, a tickle promising adventure! He tumbled from his cot. Today was THE day! The brand-new rabbit pen!

Outside, birdsong buzzed. Wake up! Fern the hedgehog was already there, a determined dynamo. Her prickles twitched with excitement. Captain Elowen stood tall. "Right then, team!" her voice boomed. "Those rabbits need a safe home before supper!"

Theo’s fingers itched. He grabbed sturdy twine. Fern scurried alongside. "We need to make it big," Theo declared, "but super safe from cheeky foxes!" They paced a rough rectangle, kicking up dew-kissed grass. Fern poked the corners. "It looks… okay," she chirped, but a doubt pricked her. It felt wobbly. They spent ages adjusting timbers, nudging posts. The pen felt clunky.

"Wait a minute," Fern squeaked suddenly. She nudged loose twine. "Look, Theo! This long string… I can make it into a circle!" She stretched it taut, then playfully pulled one side. With a twist, she pulled the sides out. Theo watched, mesmerized. The twine held its shape!

"That's it!" he exclaimed. He grabbed another twine piece. He carefully made sure all corners were square. He measured each side. "When the twine is the same length all around," he explained, his voice ringing with discovery, "like this square, it holds the MOST space inside! It's the best shape for keeping things contained!" He rushed to show Captain Elowen his sketch. "For the same boundary, Captain," he declared proudly, "a square gives us the biggest area for the rabbits!"

Captain Elowen tapped her chin, a knowing smile spreading. "Brilliant, Theo! And practical, Fern!" she declared. "You've discovered efficient boundaries!" With this purpose, Theo and Fern worked like a whirlwind. Theo measured and cut timbers. Fern darted about, securing netting. They used twine as their guide, stretching it taut. The pen took shape – proportioned, strong, secure. Captain Elowen’s sharp eyes checked each join. "Excellent work, team!" she declared. "A boundary built with brains!"

By late afternoon, the pen stood proud. A family of timid rabbits ventured out. With hesitant hops, they explored their new, spacious, secure home. Theo beamed, his heart thrumming with pride. Fern puffed out her chest. "We figured it out," she whispered. Theo nodded. "Yes! By checking how much fence we used – the perimeter – we got the most space, the biggest area, inside!" Captain Elowen clapped her hands. "Precisely! Knowing your measurements, your perimeter and your area, helps you build the best enclosure. It’s a secret code for making things work!" Theo grinned, energy coursing through him. "I wonder," he said, his eyes sparkling with curiosity, "what other secrets are hidden in plain sight?" And with a grin bright as the sun, Theo raced back towards the workshop, ready for whatever exciting discoveries came next!
characters: Theo the workshop helper, Fern the hedgehog, Captain Elowen
